items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: John has Johnnie's been a mentor with me until I finally woke up and learned a few things.

ctx.x: Oh, a guy named Johnnie Board. He's a fine musician but he's still there. Earl Phillips is another, a good drummer. Gee, I can't think of -- that goes back a good while now. It's hard for me to remember those names, you know?
Who was the leader of the group?
